name: Pokemon Manager
description: PKHeX-powered save manager: move Pokémon between games, perform trade evolutions, and inject Mystery Gifts, Mystery Events and e-Reader cards.
author: ProClifo

changelog.v0.2.52: English Black/White and Black 2/White 2 ROMs no longer show Japanese names. Anbernic H700 build uses NextUI v6.15.0.
changelog.v0.2.53: Hidden setting for beta testers: add beta_updates=true to PokemonManager/settings.txt to be offered beta releases in Update.
changelog.v0.2.54: No more black flash between screens. settings.txt now lists every setting, including beta_updates=false.
changelog.v0.2.55: Screens switch instantly, like NextUI's own menus. The first save opens faster.
changelog.v0.2.56: Reads RetroArch's compressed saves. Each save is checked after writing; if it didn't save correctly, the backup is put back. Shorter decoration message.
